title: The Rock Poster Society website
lede: The San Francisco rock poster society’s site: a dense contemporary psychedelic festival poster on a deep blue ground of wavy lines.
summary: A dense psychedelic poster beside dark blue panels, on a navy ground of fine wavy lines.

evidence.note: Captured with `tools/capture.mjs` (headless Chrome, 1440 × 900) on 28 September 2026 and inspected. The screenshot shows the first viewport; the measurement covers up to four screens. A small reCAPTCHA badge sits at lower right.

styles.note: Borderline: the poster image and the rippling background pattern are in the style, and the logo uses psychedelic lettering, but the page chrome is a dark, conventional layout with a plain sans. Much of the style here is in the displayed artwork.

observed: The ground is a deep navy blue covered with fine, wavy horizontal lines like ripples.

A tall poster at left is filled edge to edge with green and gold faces, eyes, birds, and radiating spikes, symmetrical about a vertical axis. Its lettering, TRPS FESTIVAL OF ROCK POSTERS and the date and venue, is swollen and bent to fit arches and banners.
At right, two dark rounded panels hold Upcoming Shows in a serif heading with sans-serif details, and the TRPS logo in gold, orange, and purple lettering with a winged eye.
The header is black with THE ROCK POSTER SOCIETY in widely spaced, thin gold capitals with Art Nouveau shapes.
interpretation: The page is a frame for poster art rather than a design in the style throughout. The rippling line ground is the part of the page chrome that carries the style.
Measured values: every metric that depends on computed color fails, because the poster is an image and the ground is dark; the screenshot has 5 hues.
borrow: Fill a dark ground with fine wavy lines to suggest liquid movement without adding color.
Set a thin, spaced Art Nouveau capital face in gold for a header wordmark.

images.alt: Rock Poster Society home page: a navy background with wavy lines, a dense green and gold psychedelic festival poster at left, and dark panels at right listing upcoming shows and the TRPS logo.
images.caption: First viewport of [trps.org](https://trps.org/).
